about: The Inn's pair scenes (the user, 2026-10-23/24, ordered with the Inn's secret word): in the Inn, the party leader talking to a companion seated there plays the pair's film the first time, both must be in the group; then the two gain `affinity`, and the companion's conversation opens as usual. `pair` is either order (the leader is one of the two, the one clicked is the other). `seen` = the save flag that keeps it from playing twice. A new pair = a new line here and its film in content/films (NpcTalk.h reads this file).
